notes:
Background: IronFen is a regional government agency responsible for operational readiness across critical water and energy assets. Need a private inference solution that can run in an air-gapped datacenter (classified network segmentation). Key ask = no outbound telemetry, local-only model weights, ability to import vendor-supplied model packages via removable media.

Calls/quotes: 2026-01-12 onsite kickoff with Ops and InfoSec — "we cannot have any managed control plane that phones home". Legal: heavy contract SLRs, indemnity, export controls. SecOps insists on HSM-backed key material and FIPS 140-2 validated cryptography.

Technical constraints: 8x A100 equivalent baseline for POC, expect sustained 10K tokens/sec across concurrency for alert triage workflows. Primary workload = incident response assistant (low-latency chat) and embeddings for document search across classified PDFs. Model preference: open weights (Llama-family and vetted open variants) with quantization profile; no hosted weights allowed.

Commercial posture: procurement-led, consolidated purchase across several departments. They opened with Redwood after our repo demo and pricing deck; concurrently evaluating internal build + Anthropic enterprise.

CRM style: shorthand notes in call: "Ops: need offline install image + upgrade runbook"; "Sec: show us KMS/HSM diagram, offline key wrap flow"; "AE: push term sheet, include SLA for on-prem support window".

Artifacts referenced: pricing deck in Drive, security FAQ draft, Fireflies transcript for kickoff. POC plan drafted but needs legal sign-off.

Tone: cautious, procurement-heavy, long procurement cycle expected but high ARR if we meet security demands.
